messages:
Lina (Docs): Quick thread: cleaning up the model-catalog card for zephyr-aurora-7b (limits + compat) and swapping an old Python snippet. Opened PRs #5201 (card) and #5202 (snippets/links).

Marco (ML Eng): I reviewed perf: zephyr-aurora-7b-quant-8 shows stable accuracy vs fp16 but we need to increase max_sequence_length to 2500 in the catalog. Latency rise is modest until ~1200 tokens, then grows ~20% by 2500. Also add compat tag about kv-cache memory behavior.

Lina (Docs): Can you propose exact text for the card and the compatibility blurb? Want to avoid implying accuracy loss.

Marco (ML Eng): Suggested card JSON changes: set "max_sequence_length": "2500" for the quant-8 variant and add "compatibility_tags": ["quant-8bit","kv-cache-memory"]. Blurb: "Note: 8-bit quantized builds may use more KV-cache memory and show increased per-token latency for very long sequences (>1200 tokens); we saw ~20% higher latency at 2500 tokens vs fp16 in our harness. No quality regressions observed in evaluation."

Ivy (SDK): On #5202 I replaced an old example that used client.generate() with a current streaming responses example and added a short migration note: "Migrate from client.generate(...) to client.responses.create(...) or client.responses.stream(...) for streaming. See examples." Also linked to the new canonical benchmark sheet Jordan shared.

Jordan (Product): Confirmed: deployment note needed — quant-8 is supported Hosted and Dedicated; Dedicated requires quant kernel flag. Suggest line: "Supported deployments: Hosted, Dedicated (requires enabling quant kernels)."

Lina (Docs): Good. Marco, please update the catalog JSON in #5201 to the 2500 value and include the compatibility_tags. Jordan, Ivy, I'll include the deployment line on the model card.

Marco (ML Eng): Updated branch with JSON change and compatibility tag. Pushed.

Ivy (SDK): #5202 updated with snippet + migration blurb + link to benchmark sheet (public). PTAL.

Lina (Docs): Quick checklist: (1) JSON updated? (2) snippet uses RedwoodClient streaming? (3) bench link canonical? (4) product ack?

Marco (ML Eng): (1) yes
Ivy (SDK): (2) yes
Jordan (Product): (3) and (4) yes — product ACK.

Lina (Docs): Merging both PRs and requesting a staging deploy. ci-bot, can you run docs staging deploy after merge?

ci-bot: Will queue a staging deploy once PRs are merged to main.

Lina (Docs): Merged. Thanks all!

Marco (ML Eng): Nice, thanks.

Ivy (SDK): Thanks team.

Jordan (Product): "Great."
